notes: Treatments, neater: long copy now flows onto extra slides evenly (A, B, C, then repeat) with a characters-per-slide limit you can set; copy is justified in a narrower column, with the title the same width and the block centred in the open space; storyboard pages share the copy beat by beat; your assistant (Claude or Codex) now looks at the actual images, not just tags, when matching stills. Also: sidebar order is Explore, Vault, Add; Instagram grabs take the enlarged post, not the feed behind it; in Vault, click outside an image to close it, and Crop is its own step (pick shapes, frame, save). Sync now stays in the sidebar when you collapse it.
